The Chamber of Reflections was the headquarters of the Planegazers before their society disappeared. It can be accessed through the Gnome Deep Hub and was used as a prison for specimen collected by the researches (a Yielothax, a Sight of Surrender and a Deepling). The Chamber is inhabited by Ghosts of Planegazers.
